name: 23686-imageprompt-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~8.29B params (~16.6 GB): a 28-layer language model (hidden 3584, 28 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, mrope) behind a 32-layer native-resolution ViT.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 640 requests (40 per stream) with an 1800 s safety cap, seed static 23686.
workload: guidellm, five data specs merged column-wise into one single-turn request: one synthetic_text (16 prompt tokens in, 160 out, min=max on both) plus four synthetic_image specs, each images_per_request 1, resolution 720p (1280x720), JPEG quality 85, content gradient, seeds 23686..23689. request_format plain and image_placeholder <|image_pad|> are both required at this engine. vLLM expands each placeholder into 1196 ids, so the engine sees 4804 prompt tokens per request against 160 of generation.
purpose: A vision assistant captioning four high-resolution photos per request for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine configuration for this setup. The load is NOT in this file -- it is scenario.json's
# `streams`.
#
# ONE LAUNCH ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE IS PART OF THIS SETUP AND CANNOT BE WRITTEN AS AN ENGINE ARG.
# It must be identical in every run:
#
#   VLLM_USE_V1=1

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# A request is 4804 prompt tokens + 160 output.
max-model-len: 8192

# LOAD-BEARING, both of them. Do not delete either as "the default": the engine is built
# in-process, under a usage context that is in NEITHER of `EngineArgs._set_default_args_v1`'s
# per-context tables, so an unset value falls through to SchedulerConfig's own multimodal
# defaults (5120 and 128) -- a different setup.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: true

# Must equal the number of `synthetic_image` entries in scenario.json exactly -- change one and
# you must change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 4}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
